legalName.zh: 可可琳纳食品贸易（上海）股份有限公司

description.zh: 可可琳纳是国内具规模的专业巧克力制造商之一，为烘焙、冰淇淋与冷冻甜品、饮品与乳品及食品工业提供纯脂巧克力、代脂巧克力、巧克力酱、耐烤与装饰巧克力等应用解决方案，围绕客户最终产品组织研发、生产与技术服务。
description.en: Cocoa-Linna is one of China's larger specialist chocolate manufacturers, supplying couverture, compound chocolate, chocolate sauces, bake-stable and decoration chocolate to bakery, ice cream and frozen dessert, beverage and dairy, and food-manufacturing customers, organising R&D, production and technical service around the customer's finished product.
